member.name: CodeActionMargin.Class
member.summary: Renders the code-action indicator (a light-bulb icon) for the visible indicator line and opens the actions menu when a left-button press lands on that line.

remarks.para: A creates the margin over its : the controller reports the indicator's line and raises a change notification when the available actions change, so a connected margin invalidates itself without further host calls.

The icon's brush and geometry are replaceable through the inherited properties (the defaults are a theme-neutral gray and the library's light-bulb icon), and hosts are expected to set the brush to their theme's hint or accent color. The left-press gesture is the library default and can be turned off with .

The default brush is a fixed theme-neutral gray rather than a dynamic resource, because a dynamic resource reference would outrank a host's style setters. The fixed brush stays visible at design time and a style setter can still override it, so a host that wants the icon to follow theme changes assigns its own theme brush.

member.name: OpensOnLeftClick
member.summary: Whether a left-button press on the indicator's line opens the actions menu, by default.
member.remarks: Set this to when the host owns the open gesture: the margin then leaves the press untouched, and the host opens the same menu through with its own anchor.
